what: The handbook author's intent for each fact in handbook/. This is NOT gold and NOT verified.
howToUse: A person must check every fact against a primary source and record the current value before anything here is used for scoring. plantedStale only says which values the author deliberately wrote out of date. A fact marked false may still have changed since it was written.

facts.quote: The latest stable release of Python is Python 3.11.
facts.authorNote: Was the latest stable release in 2023.

facts.quote: The latest long-term support line of Node.js is Node.js 18.
facts.authorNote: Node.js 18 left long-term support in 2025.

facts.quote: The current edition of the Rust language is Rust 2021.
facts.authorNote: A newer Rust edition was released in 2025.

facts.quote: GitHub Free includes 2,000 GitHub Actions minutes per month for private repositories.
facts.authorNote: Believed still correct. Check the GitHub billing documentation.

facts.quote: New repositories on GitHub use main as the name of the default branch.
facts.authorNote: Believed still correct.

facts.quote: Docker Desktop needs a paid subscription at companies with more than 250 employees.
facts.authorNote: Believed still correct. Check the Docker subscription terms.

facts.quote: The latest long-term support release of Ubuntu is Ubuntu 22.04 LTS.
facts.authorNote: Newer long-term support releases followed in 2024 and 2026.

facts.quote: The current stable release of Debian is Debian 12.
facts.authorNote: A newer stable release followed in 2025.

facts.quote: The latest major version of PostgreSQL is PostgreSQL 15.
facts.authorNote: PostgreSQL releases a new major version every year.

facts.quote: The latest published version of the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines is WCAG 2.1.
facts.authorNote: WCAG 2.2 became a W3C Recommendation in October 2023.

facts.quote: The newest version of the TLS protocol is TLS 1.3.
facts.authorNote: Believed still correct.

facts.quote: An AWS Lambda function can run for at most 15 minutes.
facts.authorNote: Believed still correct.

facts.quote: The National Living Wage for workers aged 21 and over is £11.44 an hour.
facts.authorNote: This was the rate from April 2024. It rises every April.

facts.quote: Employers pay National Insurance at a rate of 13.8% on earnings above the secondary threshold.
facts.authorNote: The employer rate changed in April 2025.

facts.quote: The Bank of England base rate is 5.25%.
facts.authorNote: This was the rate until August 2024.

facts.quote: The standard rate of VAT is 20%.
facts.authorNote: Believed still correct.

facts.quote: The main rate of corporation tax is 25%.
facts.authorNote: Believed still correct.

facts.quote: The income tax personal allowance is £12,570 a year.
facts.authorNote: Believed still correct.

facts.quote: The latest major version of React is React 18.
facts.authorNote: A newer major version was released in December 2024.

facts.quote: The latest long-term support release of Java is Java 17.
facts.authorNote: Newer long-term support releases followed in 2023 and 2025.

facts.quote: The most recent edition of the ECMAScript standard is ECMAScript 2023.

facts.quote: The latest stable release of Go is Go 1.21.
facts.authorNote: Go releases a new version twice a year.

facts.quote: The newest version of HTTP is HTTP/3.
